shortDescription.default: Outlook-style search over the firm's email archive in Azure AI Search.

longDescription.default: Three-pane Outlook-style web part: search bar with type-ahead and Outlook query syntax (from:, to:, subject:, before:, after:, hasattachment:), a date-grouped message list, and a reading pane showing the extracted text of each .eml and its attachments. Backed by the matters-eml-index on the rse-matterssearch Azure AI Search service over the samatters/matters blob container.
